I only work with individuals who are ready to put the work in. If you are looking for a magic pill, leave this page.
Do I need access to a full commercial gym?
Yes. To maximize hypertrophy and progressive overload, you need access to barbells, dumbbells, and standard cable machines. This is not a bodyweight home-workout program.
I have a busy schedule. Will this work for me?
Absolutely. The program is tailored to your lifestyle. Whether you can train 3 days a week or 6 days a week, the volume and nutrition protocols are adjusted to fit your exact availability.
Is the meal plan going to be boring chicken and rice?
No. I teach you how to track macros and incorporate foods you actually enjoy. Adherence is the #1 driver of results. If you hate the diet, you won't stick to it. We build a sustainable model.
Ready to do the work? Spots are strictly limited.
